messages:
sophia-cs: Heads-up — AegisCorp says the contract promo credit from their PO didn't land on their invoice. PO: PO-99224, contract promo: 75k credits. They reported it this morning. Can someone check why the promo note didn't map?
kevin-sales: Thanks Sophia. Customer ticket #CS-4128. They pasted the PO note exactly: "Apply ACQ_PROMO_2025 on next invoice". Sales added the note during procurement.
amir-finance: Pulling ledger now. Do we have customer account id and invoice #?
sophia-cs: Account: aegis_123 (internal). Most recent invoice INV-8872 (dated 2025-11-03). I see a credit line in our billing DB but it's assigned to aegis_legacy_12 (old account we merged). Looks like PO note mapping may have used old account id.
lily-eng: Can you paste the API call / event that triggered the credit? I can search logs for mapping. If you have request id that will help.
sophia-cs: From customer transcript, our sales portal logged: request_id=rc-20251103-9f4b. Attached snippet: ```POST /api/v1/internal/po_notes applyPromo { "po": "PO-99224", "note": "ACQ_PROMO_2025" }```
billing-bot: ledger-entry created: LE-554321 (credit 75000 units) -> linked_account: aegis_legacy_12, created_by: sales-service, created_at: 2025-11-03T14:12:07Z
amir-finance: Ok that's the problem. The sales-service used the legacy account id during PO ingestion. Need manual reallocation to aegis_123 and GL code mapping to ACQ_PROMO. I can approve once we have an ops ticket and audit trail.
kevin-sales: I'll open a billing-adjust ticket and include the PO note + request id + customer acceptance email. Action: create internal ticket and tag @amir-finance for approval.
sophia-cs: Ticket created: BILL-9814. Summary: move LE-554321 from aegis_legacy_12 -> aegis_123, apply GL: PROMO-ACQ-2025, note PO-99224. Added CS and Sales logs.
maria-ops: FYI, manual journal adjustments need two approvers per finance policy for >50k credits. Amir, can you +1? Finance will then run the adjustment in billing portal.
amir-finance: +1. I approve the reallocation. Need confirmation that customer won't be double-credited if we reapply.
lily-eng: Quick check — is there a corresponding webhook or retry that would re-trigger promo apply on the correct account? If so we'll block it or flag idempotent. I can add a transient guard.
sophia-cs: Customer confirmed they haven't received any credit on their invoice. They're waiting for us to fix before month-end.
maria-ops: Ops runbook: 1) record audit snapshot `SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE id='LE-554321';` -> save to ticket. 2) issue journal reallocation via Billing Portal > Adjustments > Reallocate -> enter new_account=aegis_123 GL=PROMO-ACQ-2025 3) attach signed approval 4) note reason and PO number.
kevin-sales: Customer-facing message draft: "We've identified the cause (internal account mapping bug). We've scheduled a manual correction and expect the credit to appear on your account within 24 hours. We'll confirm when done." OK to send? :thumbsup:
sophia-cs: Send it. I've already messaged the customer and included the ticket link.
amir-finance: I've signed off on BILL-9814 in the approval queue. Maria, please proceed.
maria-ops: Running manual reallocation now. Will paste commands and snapshots below.
maria-ops: Snapshot before change: ```ledger_id=LE-554321 account=aegis_legacy_12 amount=75000 gl=PROMO-ACQ-2025 created_by=sales-service created_at=2025-11-03T14:12:07Z```
maria-ops: Adjustment command (billing portal UI): select LE-554321 -> Reallocate -> New Account: aegis_123 -> GL: PROMO-ACQ-2025 -> Reason: "PO-99224 sales promo applied to merged account" -> Submit
maria-ops: Submitted. Billing system job id JOB-7721. It will run asynchronous ledger reindex and emit webhook billing-reindex:job_complete when done.
billing-bot: job-notification: JOB-7721 started -> expected completion 10m
lily-eng: I'll watch the webhook and confirm that the mapping now points to aegis_123. If any retry logic remains we should patch sales-service to use canonical account id.
billing-bot: job-notification: JOB-7721 completed -> reallocated LE-554321 -> new_account=aegis_123 -> status=success
maria-ops: Post-change snapshot: ```ledger_id=LE-554321 account=aegis_123 amount=75000 gl=PROMO-ACQ-2025 reallocated_by=maria-ops reallocated_at=2025-11-03T15:04:12Z```
amir-finance: Verified audit snapshots and GL mapping. Approved final sign-off. Finance reconciler will pick up change and update AR.
sophia-cs: Customer notified that fix is applied and credit should reflect within 24 hours. They asked for a short confirmation email once it's visible.
kevin-sales: Sending customer note now and CC'ing finance & ops.
sophia-cs: Thanks team. For follow-up: small ops task to update sales-service onboarding to always map to `canonical_account_id` during PO ingestion. Filed dev ticket ENG-4457 and linked to BILL-9814.
lily-eng: I'll take ENG-4457. Quick mitigation: adding a guard in ingestion flow so created_by=sales-service will validate account id mapping and reject if legacy id is supplied. Will follow up with PR.
sophia-cs: Marking this thread resolved. If credit doesn't show by 2025-11-04 EOD, reopen BILL-9814. :white_check_mark:
